summary: Decodes a 16-bit packed texture block to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pointer as this[6] (+0x18) + a3 * this[1045] (+0x1054) + a2 * this[1044] (+0x1050), then loops over this[1046] (+0x1058) pixels (2 source bytes each), writing 4 floats per pixel: first = sign-extended low 5 bits of the low byte * 0.0625, second = sign-extended 5 bits of (word >> 5) * 0.0625, third = 0.0, fourth = (word >> 10) * 0.015873017. If the this[4] (+0x10) flag is set, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float buffer before returning.

operations.description: Compute the source block base pointer: this[6] (+0x18) + a3 * this[1045] (+0x1054) + a2 * this[1044] (+0x1050), selecting the row (a3) and slice (a2) within the texture.
Iterate over this[1046] (+0x1058) pixels, from v5 to v5 + 2 * this[1046] (2 source bytes per pixel), writing 4 floats per pixel; a4 advances by 4 floats per iteration.
Write the first float as ((char)(8 * *v5) >> 3) * 0.0625: the low 5 bits of the low byte sign-extended to 8 bits and scaled by ~1/16; scale constant materialized from read global 0x0059E9E0.
Write the second float as ((char)(8 * (word >> 5)) >> 3) * 0.0625: bits 5-9 of the 16-bit word sign-extended and scaled by ~1/16; scale constant materialized from read global 0x0059E9E0.
Write the third float as 0.0 for every pixel.
Write the fourth float as (word >> 10) * 0.015873017: the 6-bit field at bits 10-15 of the word scaled by ~1/63; scale constant materialized from read global 0x005ACCDC.
If this[4] (+0x10 flag) is non-zero, run the post-processing pass on the decoded float buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output buffer base), where the base is a4 - 4 * this[1046] floats after the loop, i.e. the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
Return (void); execution ends after the optional post-processing pass.
